verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's centred stack and a clear headline > subhead > CTA order. Its flaws: the subhead wraps and leaves 'four flavours.' as a short orphan line, the CTA has lost its pill shape and is oversized, and the subhead, button and bottom margin are jammed together while there is extra room at the top. B breaks the single central axis by putting a ragged, centred three-line subhead beside the CTA in an off-centre bottom row, so the lower half looks arbitrary and the subhead gets squeezed small, although the pill button survives.
